snippet.title: Gameplay Trailer : 'The Duck Amikaze Strikes Back'
snippet.description:
🦆Play 'The Duck Amikaze Strikes Back' on Steam on June 17th 2025: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413520/The_Duck_Amikaze_Strikes_Back/

Help Amikaze get his revenge! Run, jump, dodge, bounce and make your way as fast as you can to blast the local hunters! Revenge your family who ended up as tenders! And beat the gold times to become THE legendary duck!

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬ FOLLOW ME HERE AND THERE ▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬

🐤Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/alexandre-rokh-mailliu-games
